html:
SMTO-CTX-0041 — SMTO tried to read a group of notes or a non-text file as one page

GUID: d11a1060-02be-5793-b2d1-fa3d80beb424
Slug: task-context-reference-kind-invalid
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: task-context

What happened

  • While working on your Task, SMTO opened a group of saved notes, or a file that isn't plain text, as if it were one readable page. Nothing in your conversation was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If the Task is still running, wait for it. SMTO usually corrects this on its next step without your help. The error tells SMTO exactly which list to open first, so it can find the right note on its own.
  2. If the Task has stopped, select Continue task, or send a short message in the same conversation such as "Please continue". A new step gives SMTO a fresh chance to open the group of notes the right way.
  3. If SMTO was trying to read a file such as a picture, PDF or archive, tell it in the conversation which text file to use instead, or attach a text version. SMTO's notes reader only reads text, so a file that isn't text can't be opened this way.

What success looks like

  • The Task moves past this step and SMTO reports what it found in the note or file.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, with the name of the file or note SMTO was trying to read. Don't change sharing or access settings to get around this; the problem is the kind of item, not access.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Task Context read targeted a section reference (section_requires_list) or a non-text artifact (unsupported_text_source) where a readable text leaf was required.

What this means

  • The selected source cannot be read using this operation. The recorded reason and operation message identify the specific condition.

Why this can happen

  • A section/reference kind is used where a readable leaf/result is required.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the operation, reason, revision and source reference recorded by the producer.

How to fix it

  • For section_requires_list, follow the returned next_action: call task_context.list with parent_reference set to the section, then task_context.read one returned leaf reference. For unsupported_text_source the artifact contains NUL bytes and cannot be decoded as text; read a text artifact or use a reader suited to that file type. Keep source access and revision checks in place.
  • List a section before reading its leaf references, or select a supported text source for text reads.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the indicated argument or refresh the source first; retain existing access checks and revision checks.

How to verify the fix

  • The corrected notebook operation succeeds.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass source access checks or overwrite a revision conflict.

Technical notes

  • An unavailable source does not prove that no relevant information exists.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0028 — SMTO couldn't find an item in this Task's saved notes
